name: vibe-gambling
description: 🎰 Every prompt is a spin. A PS1-style roulette that pops up while Claude Code thinks. Fake coins only.

serverUrl.title: Server URL
serverUrl.description: vibe-gambling server. Change it with /vibe-server to play on a self-hosted instance.

autoOpen.title: Open the window on every prompt
autoOpen.description: Open the roulette window when you send a prompt and it is not open yet.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the mod's messages: auto (system language), en or es.

turnTimeoutMs.title: Turn request timeout (ms)
turnTimeoutMs.description: Timeout of the requests made during a turn (100-1500). A turn never waits longer.

commandTimeoutMs.title: Command request timeout (ms)
commandTimeoutMs.description: Timeout of the requests made by the slash commands (500-30000).

windowReopenCooldownMs.title: Window reopen cooldown (ms)
windowReopenCooldownMs.description: After opening the window, how long to wait for it to connect before opening another one.

windowSize.title: Window size
windowSize.description: Size of the app-mode window, WIDTH,HEIGHT.

launchTimeoutMs.title: Browser launch timeout (ms)
launchTimeoutMs.description: How long the browser launcher may take to return (500-30000).

revealMaxDelayMs.title: Max result reveal delay (ms)
revealMaxDelayMs.description: Longest wait before the result toast, so it never spoils the spin (0-120000).
